headline: Check Waterfall Tickets and Accessible Route Booking
reservation: Check the official Raby Estates page for waterfall admission and current visitor arrangements. The woodland route includes an accessible waterfall-view option with a bookable tramper; confirm availability directly before departure. Hotel accommodation and seasonal events have separate arrangements.

days.title: Upper Teesdale Woodland and Falls
days.start: Suggested: 10 AM at High Force; check current entry hours

stops.name: High Force Waterfall
stops.detail: Follow the circular woodland route past sculptures to reach the base of this 21-meter waterfall. The walk to the base typically takes 20 minutes, while the full woodland circuit can be completed in just under an hour.

days.driving: Walking visit: the operator describes a 20-minute walk to the falls or a woodland circuit of just under an hour, depending on pace.
days.note: Pacing is a suggestion; an accessible route is available for the waterfall view with a bookable tramper.

intel.title: Raby Estates App
intel.text: An accessible waterfall-view route and a bookable tramper are listed by the operator. Confirm current availability and requirements before travelling.

plan.arrival: Check current waterfall admission and access before beginning the woodland walk. Confirm the bookable tramper arrangement directly if you need the accessible route.
plan.vehicle: Check actual rental and local road restrictions before travel, and confirm parking suitability with the operator before bringing a larger vehicle.
plan.goldenHour: High Force Waterfall is a possible photography stop during permitted visitor hours. Choose lighting to suit the season and check current access before planning an evening visit.
